Only methods declared in sugar-ignore/src, or inherited from a parent declared there, are listed. A type that extends a class outside that tree, such as \RuntimeException, does not show the methods of that class.

SugarCraft\Ignore

Automaton final class

Backtrack-free matcher for one Pattern, built lazily by subset construction.

MethodSummary
static for(Pattern $pattern): self
match(string $subject): ?boolMatch the WHOLE of $subject; null when it cannot be decided in budget.

IgnoreRules final class

gitignore-style ignore matching over INJECTED file contents (no IO).

MethodSummary
static new(?string $root = null): selfAn empty ruleset: nothing is ignored.
static fromPaths(array $files, ?string $root = null): self
withFile(string $path, string $contents): selfA copy that also carries $contents for $path (replacing an existing entry).
ignores(string $relPath, bool $isDir): ?stringThe reason $relPath is ignored as <ignore file>: <pattern>, or null when it is not.
isIgnored(string $relPath, bool $isDir): boolBoolean form of ignores().
undecidableRules(): arrayRules too expensive to decide, resolved toward hiding, as [ignore file, pattern] once each. Empty is the normal case; exposed so a caller can say WHY a path it expected is missing.
undecidablePatterns(): arrayundecidableRules() as <file>: <pattern> strings.

Pattern final class

One compiled gitignore line: the token list plus the flags the matcher needs.

MethodSummary
static parse(string $line): ?selfParse one ignore-file line; null for blanks, comments and lines git itself would skip (a malformed bracket expression is a broken line in someone's file, not a reason to fail the search).
pcreMatch(string $subject): ?boolDoes the compiled regex accept $subject? Null when PCRE errored.

Token final class

Token-type tags of a compiled Pattern; a token is [type, payload].
